defects.quote: **Expected:** at most 1 of the 20 seeds rejects either null
defects.evidence: If the test is correct, each seed rejects with probability at most 0.05 (family-wise). Over 20 seeds the count is Binomial(20, 0.05), so P(≥2 rejections) = 1 − 0.95²⁰ − 20·0.05·0.95¹⁹ ≈ 1 − 0.358 − 0.377 ≈ 0.26. A correct implementation fails this oracle about a quarter of the time, depending on which fixed seeds were picked.
defects.fix: Change to "at most 4 of the 20 seeds reject either null (P(≥5) ≈ 0.003 under a correct test)", or use 200 seeds and require the rejection rate ≤ 0.08. Update the Tolerance to match.
